The role holder will report to the BCO Team Lead and will work closely with the Coverage and Transaction Support teams to ensure seamless customer experience and consistency of service for all customers.

 Knowledge and Experience
   

  

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, or a related field
* 5\-8 years corporate lending experience with strong analytical skills and sound credit knowledge
* Strong understanding of various financing instruments and banking products for Wholesale Banking
* Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to navigate complex situations and drive alignment among senior leaders
